iso_metric_holes.csv.title: ISO metric holes: coarse pitch, tap drill, clearance, counterbore and countersink
iso_metric_holes.csv.basis: Coarse pitch per ISO 261; tap drill about d - P per ISO 2306; clearance fine/medium/coarse per ISO 273; counterbore for ISO 4762 heads per DIN 974-1 (head dk max plus clearance, depth = k plus 0.4-0.6 mm); 90 deg countersink at the theoretical ISO 10642 head diameter (no M18 in ISO 10642).
iso_metric_holes.csv.source: Values encoded from the standards' published dimension tables; cross-checked against bd_warehouse's clearance_hole_sizes.csv and tap_hole_sizes.csv.
iso_metric_holes.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard documents themselves are not reproduced.

iso4762_length_range.csv.title: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw nominal length range, M3-M12
iso4762_length_range.csv.basis: Shortest and longest commercial nominal length per size, as tabled by bd_warehouse.

deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.title: Single-row deep-groove ball bearings 608, 60xx and 62xx: boundary dimensions, mass, dynamic load rating
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.basis: Boundary dimensions d x D x B and minimum corner chamfer r_s per ISO 15; basic dynamic load rating C (for ISO 281 L10 life) and mass from the manufacturer's catalogue, rounded.
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.source: SKF general catalogue values (rounded); 608, 6000 and 6200 cross-checked against bd_warehouse's bearing table.
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.licence: Dimensions and ratings are published facts; no catalogue text or drawings reproduced.
